detailed_descriptions.en: Endless chaos reverberates throughout a world where the only constant is war. In an effort to overcome the turmoil, the people decide to create a little warrior. But this white-haired, god-like entity has a major case of social anxiety?! She turns the once apocalyptic, barren world into a new one filled with races and civilizations previously known only from mythology and fairy tales, and grants the mysterious power of The Source to its inhabitants, including humans. Voice of Belldona takes place in this fantastic world created by Cheryl and tells the story of her adventures after being unexpectedly awakened again. Step into a collapsing universe where cosmic horrors, corrupted machines, and winged god-engines roam the void. Voice of Belldona blends sci-fantasy atmosphere with tactical roguelike deckbuilding: summon allies, control the battlefield’s formation, and clash against everything from twisted robots to Pegasus-like divine war machines. What starts as clean strategy soon becomes a dance of positioning, timing, and high-risk decisions that can reshape your entire build. In this game, you need to decide how to carve your path through The Vortex Zone. Do you want to dash into battle as Rinsana or command the field with Griza ’s summons? Each hero plays differently, offering unique strategies and routes to mastery. Build your deck through every battle you fight, and every path you take can alter the cards you obtain. Shape your strategy to enhance the sense of progression and further increase the tactical depth of each run. Every choice reshapes your build, and every build opens new ways to outsmart the void. Explore shifting maps where no two runs are ever the same. Each route presents new events, unpredictable rewards, and bosses that can appear in different sequences. Your decisions on the map are just as important as your decisions in combat. Let your deck spiral, twist the map’s fate, and break the run in ways the void never intended. Now when reality starts folding… Will you be the one to reach the True Ending and survive what’s inside?
